title: Reduction of polynomial completion fibres to complete local domains
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian complete local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], $Q$ a maximal ideal of $S[x]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] contracting to the maximal ideal of $S$, and $s$ a prime of $S[x]_Q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. There exist a Noetherian complete local domain $A$, a maximal ideal $q$ of $A[x]$ contracting to its maximal ideal, and a prime $r\subseteq q$ contracting to zero in $A$, such that geometric regularity [def-weil-pbc-g-ring] of $\kappa(r)\otimes_{A[x]}(A[x]_q)^\wedge$ implies geometric regularity of $\kappa(s)\otimes_{S[x]_Q}(S[x]_Q)^\wedge$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion].

source.place: Proof of Proposition 07PV, paragraph 2 (reduction modulo the contraction), and proof of 07PN; Algebra Tags 00E3, 00C9, 00MA, 0325, 07BH.

proof.text: Contract s to r0 and then to p in S. Construct A=S/p. Use quotient_complete_local and the polynomial quotient map to prove A is a complete Noetherian local domain, and its image primes satisfy all required contraction and order properties.
Apply the compatible residue-field and fibre ring equivalences for this actual coefficient quotient. Transport geometric regularity along them using isGeometricallyRegular_of_fieldIso.

proof_origin.place: Proof of 07PV, coefficient quotient reduction; 07PN completion fibre identity

lean.statement:
theorem exists_completeLocalDomain_fibre_reduction
    (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [IsNoetherianRing S] [IsLocalRing S]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S) S]
    (Q : Ideal (Polynomial S)) [Q.IsMaximal]
    (hQ : Q.comap (Polynomial.C : S →+* Polynomial S) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S)
    (s : Ideal (Localization.AtPrime Q)) [s.IsPrime] :
    ∃ (A : Type u) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : IsDomain A) (_ : IsNoetherianRing A)
      (_ : IsLocalRing A) (_ : IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)
      (q r : Ideal (Polynomial A)) (_ : q.IsMaximal) (_ : r.IsPrime),
      q.comap (Polynomial.C : A →+* Polynomial A) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ∧
      r ≤ q ∧ r.comap (Polynomial.C : A →+* Polynomial A) = ⊥ ∧
      (Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular r.ResidueField
        (r.Fiber (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q))
          (Localization.AtPrime q))) →
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular s.ResidueField
          (s.Fiber (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Q))
            (Localization.AtPrime Q))))
